title: Segmentation CLI gaps: control fires any row by action name, click takes modifiers, model opens a path, and the region tool selects and frames a region by number or part
description:
Found by CRAW-42 while driving the ring and region tools through ixdar-cli only; the crawfish segmentation skill (CRAW-76) must not have to explain keys or workarounds, so these are fixed in the CLI instead (user rulings 2026-10-24).

1. Action names, not key combos. `control` picks a row by its key label ("T", "shift+H") and only searches tool rows, so saving (a scene row, Ctrl+S) needs `key CTRL+S`. Every ControlHint row, scene or tool, gets a stable action name (save, bisect, switch-mode, hide-selected, ...), listed by `tools` (and the scene's own rows alongside), and `control --action <name>` fires it (switching tool first as now). Key labels stay what `key` takes; the agent never needs them.
2. `click --mods shift` (and ctrl/alt): one call instead of key press, click, key release.
3. `model --path <file.dsl>` opens a DSL by path in the running scene (the scene's own model included, so a save can be checked by reopening it without restarting a 4 GB crawfish scene). Agents never edit a DSL by hand: ring edits go through the tools and the tool's save.
4. The region tool selects a region by its number or part label (CRAW-42) and frames the camera on it, as one action (a ControlHint row taking an argument, driven through the general routes, or the existing frame --region extended to select); no region-specific route.
definition-of-done:
1. `tools` lists every row's action name, scene rows included; `control --action save` saves; no row needs its key label to be fired.
2. `click --mods shift` adds to a region selection in one call.
3. `model --path` opens a tmp copy and reopening the scene's own file after a save shows the saved rings and labels, without a restart.
4. Selecting region N or part P selects it and frames it in one call; the reply carries the tool outcome.
5. Java and test_cli tests for each; gen-docs run.
testing-plan:
1. mvn test, test_cli.
2. Live on a tmp copy of IMG_4111: select a part by label, shift-click a second region, name it via `terminal --line "lb <name>"`, `control --action save`, `model --path` the same file, check rings and labels came back.
changes-made: Action names: ControlHint derives actionName from its description in its constructor (words up to the first : ; , or (, lower case, the/a/an dropped, joined by -; empty for display-only rows). tools lists every row's action (tool rows and a new sceneControls list from Scene.sceneControlsStart); control --action fires a tool's row, then the scene's own rows, by exact name or by leading words when they begin one name only (save -> save-rings), switching tool first; --key still works; unknown or ambiguous names are refused with the candidate names. Rows sharing a name share a description (redo on ctrl+shift+Z and ctrl+Y, remove-anchor on del and backspace).

click --mods shift|ctrl|alt (+-separated): InjectClick presses the modifier keys on the scene's KeyGuy as InjectKey does, passes the mask to the button events, and releases them in a finally; KeyNames.modifiers(text, endsInKey) parses both key specs and bare modifier lists.

model --path <file>: SwitchModel resolves the path with ModelCatalog.launchChoice (as -Dixdar.model does), keeps the scene's current ModelChoice when the path is its own file, refuses a missing file, and goes through requestModelLoad/applyPendingModel; name became an optional positional.

Region tool: a ControlHint row taking an argument (new ControlHint(key, description, Consumer<String>), fired only by control --argument) 'select and frame regions' (select-and-frame-regions, key label 'region numbers'): next frame it picks each numbered region at one face centroid, reselects, and frames the camera on the selection with SelectionBounds; bad numbers set lastError. Chosen over extending frame --region so the reply is the tool outcome and frame stays side-effect free. Part labels (CRAW-42) are not on master: a non-numeric field is refused today and is where the label lookup goes.

Master fixes the build needed: RingTool.DESCRIPTION constant returned by desc() (same as the review branches) and the missing period in automation/endpoints/ui/tools/package-info.java. Tests: ToolInputReplyTest (action, leading words, scene row, unknown action, sceneControls, click --mods shift), RegionControlAutomationTest (names per scope, save by leading word, select-and-frame by number from another tool, shift-click adds a region), ModelPathReopenTest, KeyNamesTest, test_cli. gen-docs NOT run: it rewrites Ixdar/CLAUDE.md's generated command list (and the CLI README); gen-docs --check reports both drifted.

After syncing onto master (CRAW-42 and CRAW-75 landed), the region tool's argument row also takes part names: 'select and frame regions' (key label 'region numbers or part names') selects every region a part labels, mixes freely with numbers (3,torso), refuses an unknown name listing the regions count and the part names, and refuses a part that labels no region. Live on the fertility tmp copy: select 3, shift-click region 7, terminal 'lb torso', control --action save wrote label_torso, model --path reopened the file and select-and-frame torso selected the same 2 regions. Supersedes the earlier note that labels were left for later.

Rework after review (supersedes the earlier action-name, argument-row and select-and-frame notes): (1) Scene.controls is a list of three sections, TOOL_SWITCH_SECTION, TOOL_SECTION, SCENE_SECTION; refreshControls fills them, Tool.addControls fills the tool's, setControls(List<ControlHint>) fills the scene's, and the frame-all F row heads the scene section. KeyGuy dispatches section by section in that order; the ctrl+I menu, the editor's InfoPane and 'ls keys' list each non-empty section under a heading (Scene.controlSectionName); ui-state controls are [{section, controls}]; tools.sceneControls is the scene section; Scene.sceneControlsStart is gone. (2) The ControlHint constructors that defaulted keyCode to NO_KEY are gone; rows with no key pass ControlHint.NO_KEY at their call site. (3) Every constructor of a firing row takes a stable action id as its first argument, given at every one of the ~120 call sites (save-rings, bisect, switch-mode, undo, redo, hide-selected, name-part, ...); a row whose description changes with state keeps one id (switch-mode; bisect on K both in the ring and in the bisector); one action under two keys shares an id (redo on ctrl+shift+Z and ctrl+Y, remove-anchor, delete-bisector-point, next-layer). Display-only rows have no id. control --action matches the id exactly, no prefixes, and refuses otherwise with the candidate ids. (4) Argument rows removed (constructor, argumentAction, takesArgument, control --argument, pendingSelection). New terminal command sel/select (SelectCommand, Subsystem.RINGS): 'sel 3,torso' switches to the region tool, brings the regions up to date, selects by region number or part name as clicks would, and frames the camera; usable by typing in the scene terminal or via ixdar-cli terminal --line. RingTool is touched only at its row construction (ids, NO_KEY) plus REDO_ACTION/BISECT_ACTION constants; DESCRIPTION stays removed. Live on the fertility tmp copy: control --action save-rings (labels and a drafted ring), sel 3, click --mods shift, lb torso, model --path reopen, sel torso. mvn test 664/0, test_cli 116/0.
review-summary: Scene controls become sections whose ControlHint rows carry stable action ids that control matches exactly; a new sel terminal command selects and frames regions by number or part, click holds modifiers, and model opens a path. Segmentation agents can then drive the ring scene through ixdar-cli without keys.
